name: claude-mods
description: Claude Code mods by namdar12: a Mermaid diagrams pane, a Claude Certified Architect practice quiz, and /park-all for upgrading with every session saved.

plugins.name: mermaid-pane
plugins.description: Claude renders Mermaid diagrams into a side pane (auto-opens on any ```mermaid block in a reply); reopen with /diagrams

plugins.name: cca-quiz
plugins.description: Multiple-choice practice for the Claude Certified Architect exams, shown above the prompt while Claude works. Toggle with /quiz.

plugins.name: session-park
plugins.description: /park-all closes every Claude Code terminal session for an upgrade; /unpark-all reopens them resumed
